ARABIC — MOCK EXAM #16
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: ARABIC
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When practising Reading Fluency, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Reading Fluency.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Reading Fluency.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Reading Fluency.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Reading Fluency.

2. When practising Phonological Awareness, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Phonological Awareness.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Phonological Awareness.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Phonological Awareness.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Phonological Awareness.

3. When practising Conversational skills, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Conversational skills.

   D. Avoid reading anything related to Conversational skills.

4. When practising Reading for Comprehension, which approach is best? (1 mark)

   D. Copy random text without understanding Reading for Comprehension.

5. When practising Selective Listening, which approach is best? (1 mark)

6. In ARABIC, the best classroom habit is: (1 mark)
   A. Practise listening, speaking, reading, and writing every day
   B. Mix random languages with no purpose
   C. Only memorise without using the language
   D. Avoid speaking to classmates

7. When practising Speaking Fluency, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Speaking Fluency.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Speaking Fluency.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Speaking Fluency.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Speaking Fluency.

8. When practising Active Listening, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Active Listening.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Active Listening.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Active Listening.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Active Listening.

9. When practising Imitative speaking, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Imitative speaking.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Imitative speaking.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Imitative speaking.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Imitative speaking.

10. When practising Intensive Reading: Short Stories, which approach is best? (1 mark)

   B. Avoid reading anything related to Intensive Reading: Short Stories.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Intensive Reading: Short Stories.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Intensive Reading: Short Stories.

----
